secret_scan_note: Marker/high-confidence-pattern scan only. All canaries are synthetic and no real workspace secret, credential or personnel datum is read, injected or recorded; zero hits mean zero marker/pattern occurrences, not a claim that real secrets were hunted. Every regular file of every layer is still scanned with the full broad pattern set and every raw hit (with matched text/context evidence) is retained under all_layer_scan.secret_pattern_hits_across_all_layers. Hits are tiered by path ownership: project-owned paths (app/, web/, config/) are zero-tolerance; site-packages hits must map data-driven to an installed distribution (via the PEP 376 RECORD manifest or dist-info/top_level.txt, with the mapping source recorded per hit) and receive a deterministic triage class (native_binary_symbol_coincidence, pem_header_string_literal, package_metadata_text or identifier_or_css_class_coincidence). Any unattributable or unclassified hit stays review_required and fails the gate closed. The raw broad-pattern zero-hit boolean is kept for honesty but is not a pass/fail gate, because public third-party libraries legitimately contain PEM header string literals, CSS class names and native symbols that coincide with token shapes.
